items.title: Bar/cafe in the Halogaland Teater
items.author: cantilever2
items.body: Through the end of summer, a very pleasant—and apparently not very well-known—place to have coffee or a drink is operating while the theatre is on break. It’s a lovely space and has a beautiful view, inside and out. It’s open 3-11 p.m. Wednesday to Friday, with additional earlier hours on Saturday and Sunday. It’s several blocks south of the Polaria Museum. Worth checking out!
